description: Capability for Lare Terminal live search-result windows (Task 11, label: 'search-*'). Grants core:default so window-search.js can invoke take_window_content / close_self via IPC and use the event API (core:event: listen for search:hit/search:done, emit search:open-path/search:cancel). Grants core:window:allow-start-dragging for the chromeless, transparent titlebar drag region. Global-shortcut and clipboard permissions are intentionally NOT included.
